relations: From the bent posture, the torso straightens as one arm lifts overhead and the other extends forward.
Turning her back to the camera, she balances on one leg while raising the free leg behind.
In the attitude pose, her head tilts back and the raised leg shifts between extended and bent.
Lowering the raised leg, she brings arms to a horizontal line and walks across the wooden floor.
caption: The video captures a woman in a pink long-sleeve top and black wide-leg trousers in a mirrored dance studio, her reflection tracking each movement. She is already bent forward at the waist, one arm curved beside her head and the other reaching toward her pointed foot. She straightens her torso, lifting one arm overhead and the other forward, then turns so her back faces the camera. Balancing on one leg, she raises the free leg behind her and opens her arms into a wide V. She holds an attitude-like pose, head tilted back, the raised leg shifting between extended and bent. Lowering the leg and bringing her arms down to a forward horizontal line, she walks away across the wood floor, still mid-stride.
